about: Eurostat Data Browser (ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser): search and browse EU statistical datasets, inspect dataset metadata, dimensions, codelists and related tables, and fetch data through the public JSON-stat dissemination API.

commands.summary: Search Eurostat datasets by keyword (autocomplete suggestions). Returns dataset codes with highlighted titles.
List every Eurostat dataflow (code, title, last data/structure update). Set comext=true for the Comext (international trade) database. Large response.

params.name: comext
params.description: true = Comext trade datasets, false = main Eurostat database

commands.summary: List top-level statistical themes (navigation tree roots). crossCutting=true returns the cross-cutting / EU-policy themes instead.

params.name: crossCutting
params.description: false = statistical themes (popul, economy, ...); true = EU policies and cross-cutting topics

commands.summary: Get the category navigation tree under a theme (e.g. popul = Population and social conditions).

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme id from list-themes, e.g. popul, economy, general

commands.summary: Get the full Eurostat navigation tree (categories and datasets), optionally only the branch under one category code.

params.name: node
params.description: Category code to restrict the tree to, e.g. une

commands.summary: List the datasets in a navigation-tree category (e.g. scheme popul, category une = unemployment), with titles, update dates and links.

params.name: category
params.description: Leaf category code holding datasets, e.g. une, lfsi

commands.summary: Get dataset metadata: title, description, observation count, time coverage, last data/structure update, DOI, source dataset, metadata links.
Check that a dataset code exists and has data; returns its canonical id, default view id and last data/structure update timestamps (ms).
List a dataset's dimensions (freq, geo, sex, age, unit, ...) with all available codes and labels. Use these codes as filters in get-data.
Get where a dataset sits in the navigation tree (theme and category breadcrumbs).
List datasets derived from this dataset and the source dataset(s) it is derived from (code -> title).
Fetch dataset values as JSON-stat from the public statistics API, filtered by dimension codes (geo, sex, age, unit, s_adj, na_item, ...) and time range.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataset code, e.g. une_rt_m, tps00203, nama_10_gdp

params.name: geo
params.description: Geo code, e.g. DE, FR, EU27_2020 (see get-dataset-dimensions / get-codelist geo)

params.name: age
params.description: Age class code, e.g. TOTAL, Y_LT25, Y25-74, Y15-74

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit code, e.g. PC_ACT, THS_PER, CP_MEUR

params.name: na_item
params.description: National accounts item, e.g. B1GQ (GDP) for nama_10_gdp

params.name: sinceTimePeriod
params.description: Only periods from this one on, e.g. 2020, 2024-01, 2023-Q1

params.name: untilTimePeriod
params.description: Only periods up to this one, e.g. 2025

params.name: lastTimePeriod
params.description: Return only the N most recent periods

commands.summary: Get all codes and labels of a Eurostat codelist (e.g. geo = countries/regions/aggregates).

params.name: codelist
params.description: Codelist id (lowercase dimension id), e.g. geo, unit, sex, age, na_item
